## What's Changed

* The menu item no longer disappears after a restart. Bing regularly sends a new version of the Search interface, and a small background helper now patches it automatically within a few seconds.
* The helper starts when you sign in, uses about 15 MB of memory and logs problems to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\SearchDesktopShortcut\watcher.log`.
* `Uninstall.cmd` also stops the helper and removes its sign-in entry.

Extract the ZIP below and run `Install.cmd` to update.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Despical/SearchDesktopShortcut/compare/v1.0.0...v1.0.1
